blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks edged lower on Thursday as investors took profits after a three-day rally, with lingering economic concerns keeping trading subdued. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) slipped 0.06 percent, or 3.28 points, to 5,490.13. The broader All Shares Index eased 0.03 percent. READ: S&P sees PH posting SE Asia’s slowest growth in 2026 Philstocks Financial Inc. attributed the pullback to profit-taking and said many investors stayed on the sidelines as they weighed stagflation risks and waited for fresh catalysts.
